description: This file defines internal static class StorageInstruments that manages metrics instrumentation for storage operations (read, write, delete) in Orleans. It includes histograms for latency measurements and counters for error counts, with methods to record these metrics.

classes.name: StorageInstruments
classes.description: Internal static class providing methods for recording storage operation metrics such as latency histograms and error counters.

methods.name: OnStorageRead
methods.description: Records a storage read latency histogram and associated tags.

methods.name: OnStorageWrite
methods.description: Records a storage write latency histogram and associated tags.

methods.name: OnStorageReadError
methods.description: Increments the read error counter with contextual tags.

methods.name: OnStorageWriteError
methods.description: Increments the write error counter with contextual tags.

methods.name: OnStorageDelete
methods.description: Records a storage delete operation latency histogram with tags.

methods.name: OnStorageDeleteError
methods.description: Increments the delete error counter with tags.
